# namespace_tenant_token (Ephemeral Resource)

Issues a short-lived Namespace Cloud tenant bearer token using partner credentials. The token is available only in-memory during Terraform operations and is not persisted to state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    namespace = {
      source = "bsuv/namespace"
    }
  }
}

variable "partner_token" {
  type        = string
  description = "Namespace Partner Token"
  sensitive   = true
  ephemeral   = true
}

provider "namespace" {
  token = var.partner_token
}

ephemeral "namespace_tenant_token" "ci" {
  tenant_id     = "tenant_corp_eng"
  actor_id      = "github-actions-builder"
  duration_secs = 3600

  policies = [
    {
      policy_type = "namespace.cloud.iam.v1beta.RunnerProfilePolicy"
      value       = jsonencode({ allow_read = true })
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `actor_id` (String) Identity of the actor requesting the token.
- `tenant_id` (String) Namespace tenant identifier for which the token is issued.

### Optional

- `access` (Attributes) Optional granular access grants scoping the token. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access))
- `duration_secs` (Number) Validity duration of the issued token in seconds. If omitted, the Namespace API default (e.g. 15 minutes) is used.
- `policies` (Attributes List) Optional list of token policies scoping permissions for the issued token. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies))

### Read-Only

- `bearer_token` (String, Sensitive) Issued short-lived tenant bearer token.
